plugin.name: Mw(spec)
plugin.description: Spectral moment magnitude Mw(spec): per-station moment magnitude from a Brune omega-square fit of the displacement spectrum. Port of the Seisan SPEC/AUTOMAG algorithm (L. Ottemoeller). Provides the amplitude processor (spectral fit, output Omega0 in nm*s with the corner frequency as the amplitude period) and the magnitude processor (Omega0 -> seismic moment -> Mw).

parameter.name: model
parameter.description: Layered spectral velocity/attenuation/density model, one list entry per depth layer. Each entry is eight whitespace-separated numbers: "depth[km] vp[km/s] vs[km/s] Qp0 Qp_alpha Qs0 Qs_alpha density[g/cm^3]". Values are linearly interpolated to the source depth (Seisan get_att_vel). Used by the amplitude processor (Q columns) and the magnitude processor (velocity/density). Example (from SEISAN.DEF): "3.0 5.8 3.2 500 0.7 400 0.7 2.6", "15.0 6.8 3.9 500 0.7 400 0.7 2.9". If unset, a single layer (vp=6.0, vs=3.5, density=3.0, no Q correction) is used.

parameter.name: phase
parameter.description: Seismic phase whose spectrum is analysed: "P" (vertical component) or "S" (horizontal). Shared by both processors.

parameter.name: attenuationTable
parameter.description: Optional path to an EMPIRICAL attenuation table (a regionally-calibrated GIT result), used INSTEAD of the parametric Q model + geometric spreading. The CSV is a frequency x hypocentral-distance grid of the additive log10 path correction A(f,r): log10(source)=log10(observed)+A, bundling geometric spreading + anelastic attenuation. When set, the amplitude processor applies A(f,rhyp) and the magnitude processor skips its own geometric spreading; set a one-time 'calibration' offset for the absolute level. Leave unset to use the parametric model (Q0/Qalpha or layered 'model'). See examples/au_attenuation_table.csv (T. Allen, Australia) and make_atten_table.py for the format.

parameter.name: Q0
parameter.description: Uniform quality factor Q0 in Q(f)=Q0*f^Qalpha (0 = no anelastic attenuation correction). REGION-DEPENDENT — set this for reliable Mw. Ignored if 'model' (layered) is set.

parameter.name: Qalpha
parameter.description: Frequency exponent in Q(f)=Q0*f^Qalpha (e.g. 0.7). Ignored if 'model' is set.

parameter.name: vp
parameter.description: Source P velocity (single-layer scalar model). Ignored if 'model' is set.

parameter.name: vs
parameter.description: Source S velocity (single-layer scalar model). Ignored if 'model' is set.

parameter.name: density
parameter.description: Source density (single-layer scalar model). Ignored if 'model' is set.

extend-struct.description: Spectral measurement parameters for Mw(spec). Note: the shared spectral model (model) and the phase are configured once in the magnitude profile magnitudes.Mw(spec) and used by both processors.

parameter.name: signalPreTime
parameter.description: Window lead before the phase onset.

parameter.name: signalDuration
parameter.description: Signal window length after the phase onset.

parameter.name: noiseGap
parameter.description: Gap between the noise and signal windows.

parameter.name: fmin
parameter.description: Fixed lower frequency for the fit. 0 enables automatic band selection from the signal-to-noise spectrum.

parameter.name: fmax
parameter.description: Fixed upper frequency for the fit. 0 enables automatic band selection (capped at samplingRate/2.5).

parameter.name: nfreq
parameter.description: Number of log-spaced spectral samples used for the fit.

parameter.name: minSNR
parameter.description: Minimum spectral signal-to-noise ratio to accept the measurement.

parameter.name: maxResidual
parameter.description: Maximum Brune-fit residual to accept the measurement.

parameter.name: calibration
parameter.description: Additive log10 calibration of the spectral flat level, used to match the absolute Omega0 level of a reference (e.g. Seisan).

parameter.name: taper
parameter.description: Apply a cosine taper before the FFT.

parameter.name: combiner
parameter.description: For phase = S only: how to combine the two horizontal components' Omega0 into one station measurement. vector_sum (default) = sqrt(N^2 + E^2), the total horizontal S-wave motion (recommended); average; geometric_mean = sqrt(N*E); max; min. Ignored for phase = P (vertical only).

parameter.name: kappaP
parameter.description: Near-surface attenuation kappa for P.

parameter.name: kappaS
parameter.description: Near-surface attenuation kappa for S.

parameter.name: qCorner
parameter.description: Q corner frequency. 0 selects the power-law Q(f)=Q0*f^alpha; a positive value selects Q(f)=Q0*(1+(f/qCorner)^alpha).

parameter.name: gridF
parameter.description: Grid nodes along corner frequency in the fit.

parameter.name: gridOm
parameter.description: Grid nodes along the flat level in the fit.

parameter.name: gridLoops
parameter.description: Zoom iterations of the grid search.

parameter.name: dkappa
parameter.description: If >0, also search a delta-kappa in {-dkappa,0,+dkappa}.

parameter.name: norm
parameter.description: Residual norm of the fit (Seisan uses 1 = L1).

extend-struct.description: Moment-magnitude parameters for Mw(spec). The shared spectral model and phase are configured under "Modules -> global" (magnitudes.Mw(spec).model / .phase).

parameter.name: radiation
parameter.description: Average radiation-pattern coefficient (Seisan uses 0.6 for P and S).

parameter.name: freeSurface
parameter.description: Free-surface amplification factor (Seisan uses 2.0).

parameter.name: geoDepth1
parameter.description: Top of the body-to-surface-wave geometric-spreading transition (S only).

parameter.name: geoDepth2
parameter.description: Bottom of the body-to-surface-wave geometric-spreading transition (S only).

parameter.name: herkijDistance
parameter.description: Epicentral distance of the Herrmann-Kijko spreading transition (S only).

parameter.name: minimumDistance
parameter.description: Reject station magnitudes closer than this epicentral distance.

parameter.name: maximumDistance
parameter.description: Reject station magnitudes beyond this distance. Set ~12 to drop teleseismic stations.

parameter.name: multiplier
parameter.description: Linear station correction a in a*Mw+b; default or "a@profile" list. Leave 1.0 for none.

parameter.name: offset
parameter.description: Constant station correction b in a*Mw+b; set per-station to remove site bias = -(site term). Leave 0.0 for none.
